configuration.description: Encoder hints only. Every member is non-normative for decoding: decoders MUST ignore the entire object and derive geometry, data type, and color encoding from the codestream. The set is open, so implementations MAY record additional implementation-specific members, and any documented member MAY be null to indicate that no hint was recorded.

distance.description: Butteraugli distance; 0 means mathematically lossless (ignored on decode).

lossless.description: Whether the codestream was encoded losslessly (ignored on decode).

level.description: libjpeg-style 0-100 quality that an encoder maps to a Butteraugli distance (ignored on decode).

primaries.description: Color primaries requested at encode time; the codestream records the authoritative value (ignored on decode).

transfer.description: Transfer function requested at encode time; the codestream records the authoritative value (ignored on decode).

usecontainer.description: Whether the encoder wrapped the codestream in the ISOBMFF container (ignored on decode; decoders accept both forms).

decodingspeed.description: Encoder tier trading file size for decode speed (ignored on decode).

photometric.description: Encoder-side color interpretation hint; the actual color encoding is recorded in the codestream (ignored on decode).

bitspersample.description: Sample bit depth requested at encode time; the codestream records the authoritative value (ignored on decode).
